Seat K1Binding: the binding rule accepts a token by substring (`log` inside `catalog`) and any line of a file a wildcard row covers (the `corpus/lessons/*.md` row bound only that way; re-anchored at integration to `corpus/QUALITY.md:143`, KQ26); its negation list is four fixed strings.
